products.pds_title: Cruise Travel Insurance Product Disclosure Statement
products.geographic_scope: International travel outside Australia; destinations selected by country/region as nominated on the Insurance certificate; Antarctica cover limited to cruises and associated excursions. Bare Essentials not available for the Worldwide Including plan.
products.eligibility_rules: Available only to Australian citizens or permanent residents, or non‑permanent residents who hold valid Medicare, Private Health Fund or Overseas Student health cover in Australia. Applicants must be 79 years of age or under at application (64 years max if trip duration is over 90 days). Policy can be purchased by persons 18+; dependent children under 18 can be covered when named.
products.age_eligibility_notes: Age 79 or under for trips up to 90 days; for trips longer than 90 days, maximum age 64 at application. Policy purchaser must be 18+. Dependent children under 18 may be covered when named.

waiting_period_rules.benefit_or_section: General waiting period after purchase when already travelling
waiting_period_rules.exceptions: No waiting period if policy bought as a continuation with no gap. For Section B – Medical and Section C1 – Additional emergency expenses, the waiting period does not apply to claims arising directly from an injury occurring after the policy issue date.
waiting_period_rules.evidence_quote: If you buy your policy after you have left your home to start travelling, cover for your trip will be subject to a 72‑hour waiting period. Under Section B – Medical and Section C1 – Additional emergency expenses, the waiting period will not apply to claims which arise directly from an injury that occurs after the policy issue date... This waiting period will not apply if you purchase a new policy as a continuation of your cover with us.

products.policy_cancellation_refund_terms: Full refund if cancelled within 21 days of purchase provided no claim has been made/exercised and travel has not commenced. After 21 days, pro‑rata refund of the unused premium less non‑recoverable taxes/charges, provided no claim has been made/exercised.
products.excess_options: Excess applies per insured person per event where indicated; amount shown on Insurance certificate. Option to vary/choose your excess at purchase (higher premium for lower excess or vice versa). Some sections have no excess as shown in the benefits table.

excess_rules.rule: Excess is deducted from claim payments per insured person per event where an excess applies; shown on Insurance certificate.
excess_rules.evidence_quote: The Table of benefits also indicates whether an excess applies... If your claim is paid, this excess is deducted... An excess is applied per insured person and if multiple events occur during a trip an excess will be applied for each event per insured person.

products.limit_basis_notes: Unless stated otherwise, sums insured apply per insured person per trip. Time-based benefits apply per completed 12 or 24-hour period as stated. Excess applies per insured person per event where indicated.
products.pre_existing_medical_conditions_summary: Pre‑existing medical conditions are excluded unless you complete medical screening, cover is offered by the insurer and any additional premium is paid (noted on the Insurance certificate). No cover for undiagnosed conditions with symptoms at purchase, travel against medical advice, or terminal prognosis expected prior to end date. Claims under Sections A or C1 arising from pre‑existing conditions of a non‑travelling relative or an uninsured travelling companion are excluded.
products.pregnancy_cover_summary: Complications of pregnancy and childbirth are covered only if they occur before the 31st week of pregnancy. Cancellation cover applies if you become pregnant after purchase and will be over 30 weeks (20 weeks for multiple pregnancy) at start/during trip, or if a doctor certifies you are unfit to travel due to complications. No cover for childbirth or newborn after policy issue date.
products.non_traveller_health_rules: No cover under Section A (Cancellation) or C1 (Additional emergency expenses) for pre‑existing medical conditions known before policy issue that affect a relative not travelling or an uninsured travelling companion. Limits for COVID-related non-traveller events: close relative must be resident in AU/NZ and life‑threatening level for some covers.
products.rental_vehicle_excess_conditions: Covers the excess only; does not replace rental vehicle insurance. Eligible vehicles: campervans/motorhomes <6t; coupe/4WD/hatchback/minibus/people mover/sedan/station wagon/SUV; motorcycles/mopeds with <9 seats. No cover if operating in breach of rental agreement, unauthorised driver, vehicles with >9 seats, off‑road use, commercial vehicles, buses, trucks, caravans/trailers, limousines. Excludes wear/tear, mechanical breakdown, tyre damage except as specified.
products.luggage_conditions: Act reasonably to protect property; carry valuables/electronics as hand luggage; obtain police/authority reports within 72 hours; property left in unattended motor vehicle covered only if locked, concealed and evidence of forced entry (max per item applies); proof of ownership required; IMEI must be supplied and blocked for mobile phones; depreciation applies per table; exclusions for unattended property in public places and certain items/categories apply.

depreciation_rules.evidence_quote: Phones, electrical devices... tablets, electronics equipment and clothing – 20% per year, maximum deduction 90%.
All other items – 10% per year, maximum deduction 90%.

products.business_cover_details: Optional Business Cover (Section O): Business equipment $2,500 (single item $1,000; samples $1,000); emergency courier $500; equipment hire $100 per 24 hours up to $1,000; business money $1,000 (cash $500); replacing staff $5,000 (International only). Standard baggage conditions/exclusions and depreciation apply to business equipment.

general_exclusions.details: No cover unless screened and accepted; undiagnosed symptoms; travel for/against medical advice; terminal prognosis before end date.
general_exclusions.evidence_quote: This policy will not cover any claims under Section A ... or Section C1 ... that result directly or indirectly from any pre‑existing medical condition...

general_exclusions.details: General pandemic/COVID-19 exclusions except for specific Section M benefits; no cover for government travel bans, border closures, quarantine not due to diagnosis.
general_exclusions.evidence_quote: This policy generally excludes cover arising from or relating to COVID‑19... This exclusion does not apply to Section M – COVID‑19 expenses.

general_exclusions.details: No cover for travel to ‘Do Not Travel’ destinations or sanctioned countries; sanction compliance applies.
general_exclusions.evidence_quote: We shall not be deemed to provide coverage ... to the extent that such cover ... would violate ... sanctions... policy will not cover ... travel in, to or through destinations that are subject to ‘Do Not Travel’ advice.

general_exclusions.details: No cover for refusal/failure by carriers/tour operators/hotels due to their own or related financial default.
general_exclusions.evidence_quote: The refusal, failure or inability of any person, company or organisation... by reason of their own financial default...

products.travel_warning_and_sanctions_rules: No cover for travel to destinations subject to Smartraveller ‘Do Not Travel’ advice; sanction/embargo compliance may void cover/benefits where prohibited. General Condition 15 and General Exclusion 11–13 apply.
products.claims_process_summary: Register any claim within 30 days after completion of travel; provide proof of ownership/value and proof of events within requested timeframes; excess may apply per event/per person; methods: phone/email/online claim form. For hospitalisation >24 hours overseas you or someone on your behalf must contact the Assistance provider as soon as possible.
products.emergency_assistance_details: 24/7 Overseas Emergency Assistance Helpline: +61 2 9333 3999. Contact as soon as possible for hospitalisation or emergency transportation, and obtain approval where practicable. If admitted >24 hours overseas, contact is required.
products.premium_factors: Destination and length of trip, selected level of cover, number of travellers and their ages; upgrades/options and chosen excess.

products.pre_existing_medical_conditions_summary: Pre‑existing medical conditions are excluded unless you complete medical screening, cover is offered by the insurer and any additional premium is paid (noted on the Insurance certificate). No cover for undiagnosed conditions with symptoms at purchase, travel against medical advice, or terminal prognosis expected prior to end date. Claims under Sections A or C1 arising from pre‑existing conditions of a non‑travelling relative or an uninsured travelling companion are excluded.
products.pregnancy_cover_summary: Complications of pregnancy and childbirth are covered only if they occur before the 31st week of pregnancy. Cancellation cover applies if you become pregnant after purchase and will be over 30 weeks (20 weeks for multiple pregnancy) at start/during trip, or if a doctor certifies you are unfit to travel due to complications. No cover for childbirth or newborn after policy issue date.
products.non_traveller_health_rules: No cover under Section A (Cancellation) or C1 (Additional emergency expenses) for pre‑existing medical conditions known before policy issue that affect a relative not travelling or an uninsured travelling companion. Limits for COVID-related non-traveller events: close relative must be resident in AU/NZ and life‑threatening level for some covers.
products.rental_vehicle_excess_conditions: Covers the excess only; does not replace rental vehicle insurance. Eligible vehicles: campervans/motorhomes <6t; coupe/4WD/hatchback/minibus/people mover/sedan/station wagon/SUV; motorcycles/mopeds with <9 seats. No cover if operating in breach of rental agreement, unauthorised driver, vehicles with >9 seats, off‑road use, commercial vehicles, buses, trucks, caravans/trailers, limousines. Excludes wear/tear, mechanical breakdown, tyre damage except as specified.
products.luggage_conditions: Act reasonably to protect property; carry valuables/electronics as hand luggage; obtain police/authority reports within 72 hours; property left in unattended motor vehicle covered only if locked, concealed and evidence of forced entry (max per item applies); proof of ownership required; IMEI must be supplied and blocked for mobile phones; depreciation applies per table; exclusions for unattended property in public places and certain items/categories apply.
